title: Rex and the Missing Moon Map
style: colourful premium 3D animated family-film illustration, soft rounded forms, rich cinematic lighting, joyful expressive faces
summary: Rex, a cheerful young T-Rex astronaut, and his small robot friend Pip search the Moon for a lost star map. By sharing clues and working together, they find it and follow it home for a well-earned rest.

characters.name: Rex
characters.visualDescription: A small, friendly young T-Rex with mint-green skin, a pale cream belly, three soft darker-green stripes down his back, large warm amber eyes, and a wide happy smile showing tiny rounded teeth. He wears a puffy white spacesuit with orange trim, a round clear helmet, orange boots, and a small orange rocket badge on his chest. His short arms, thick tail, and boots are always fully visible.

characters.name: Pip
characters.visualDescription: A small friendly robot, knee-high to Rex, with a rounded silver body, a single big round blue eye, two thin antennae with tiny yellow lights, short stubby tracks instead of legs, and a small hatch on its chest that glows soft yellow. Pip's whole body and tracks are always fully visible.

cover.narration: Rex and the Missing Moon Map

pages.text: Rex the young T-Rex astronaut loved exploring. Today he landed his little rocket on the silvery Moon, with his best friend Pip the robot rolling happily beside him.
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, a small friendly mint-green young T-Rex with cream belly, three darker-green back stripes, amber eyes and happy smile, in a puffy white spacesuit with orange trim, clear round helmet, orange boots and orange rocket badge, stands beside Pip, a knee-high rounded silver robot with one big blue eye, two antennae with tiny yellow lights, stubby tracks and a glowing yellow chest hatch. They stand on grey Moon dust beside a small red-and-white rocket, under a deep navy starry sky. Whole characters visible.

pages.text: "Time to fly home," said Rex. He reached into his pocket for his star map, which showed the way back to Earth. But the pocket was empty. The map was gone!
pages.imagePrompt: Close scene on grey Moon dust: Rex, the small mint-green T-Rex in his white and orange spacesuit with clear helmet, looks surprised, patting the front pocket of his suit with his short arm while Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye, antennae and tracks, watches. A starry navy sky above. Both characters fully in frame.

pages.text: "Don't worry," said Pip kindly. "We can find it together. I saw a sparkly corner near the big crater!" Rex smiled. Clues were much easier with a friend.
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the mint-green young T-Rex in his white and orange spacesuit, smiles down at Pip, the small silver robot with one blue eye and yellow-lit antennae, who points one thin arm towards a large smooth crater in the distance. Grey Moon dust, starry sky. Both characters fully visible.

pages.text: At the big crater, something glimmered in the dust. It was a shiny corner of paper! As Rex stepped closer, his boot nudged the dust, and the paper slipped downhill.
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the mint-green T-Rex astronaut, and Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye and tracks, peer into a large grey crater. A small white paper corner glimmers in the Moon dust, with a gentle swirl of dust drifting downhill. Starry navy sky. Both characters fully in frame.

pages.text: Rex tried to reach it, but his arms were too short. Pip rolled after it, but the dusty slope was too steep for little tracks. They stopped and thought together.
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the mint-green T-Rex in his white and orange spacesuit, stretches his short arm down a dusty grey slope while Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye, tilts on its tracks partway down. A white paper corner lies just out of reach. Both characters fully visible, starry sky above.

pages.text: "I have an idea," said Rex. "You are small and steady. I am tall and strong. If we hold hands, we can reach it together!" Pip beeped happily. Teamwork time!
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the tall mint-green T-Rex astronaut, leans down the grey dusty slope holding Pip's thin robot hand; Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye and tracks, stretches towards a white paper corner in the dust. Both characters fully in frame, starry navy sky above.

pages.text: Carefully, slowly, Rex held Pip out over the slope. Pip's little gripper arm stretched, stretched, stretched... and caught the paper corner! Up they came together, safe and sound.
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the mint-green T-Rex in his white and orange spacesuit, lies on his belly at the top of a grey dusty slope, holding Pip's hand as the small silver robot with blue eye reaches down and grips a white paper corner. Both characters fully visible, starry sky above.

pages.text: The map was a little crumpled, but every star was still there. "Look!" said Rex. "The map shows a path to a quiet crater. That sounds like the perfect rest stop."
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the mint-green T-Rex astronaut, and Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye and antennae, sit side by side on grey Moon dust, looking at a slightly crumpled white star map with dotted lines and star shapes held between them. Both characters fully in frame, starry navy sky.

pages.text: They followed the dotted line across the silver hills, past small craters, all the way to their little rocket waiting patiently under the stars.
pages.imagePrompt: Wide scene: Rex, the mint-green T-Rex in his white and orange spacesuit, and Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye and tracks, walk side by side across gentle silver Moon hills towards a small red-and-white rocket. A dotted line of tiny star shapes trails behind them. Both characters fully visible, starry navy sky.

pages.text: Rex tucked the map safely away and patted Pip's warm metal head. "We did it together," he said. And the two friends flew home, sleepy, smiling, and ready for the next adventure.
pages.imagePrompt: Rex, the mint-green T-Rex astronaut in his white and orange spacesuit, gently pats the head of Pip, the small silver robot with blue eye and glowing yellow chest hatch, as they sit together inside a cosy rocket window seat, Earth glowing blue outside the window. Both characters fully visible, warm soft lighting.
